lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a conditional guard e g only set if absent whose protected branch is db key gated needs its own offline discriminating test that reproduces the pre condition ordering e g a class scoped fixture presetting the value before the function scoped autouse fixture or the discrimination sensor flags the guard as uncovered
lessons.text: A conditional guard (e.g. only-set-if-absent) whose protected branch is DB/key-gated needs its own offline discriminating test that reproduces the pre-condition ordering — e.g. a class-scoped fixture presetting the value before the function-scoped autouse fixture — or the discrimination sensor flags the guard as uncovered.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an implicit requirement sweep resolves a bounds limits dimension name the concrete bound page size cap or deliberately unbounded because x bounded like the shipped list conventions names no assertion and wsn 11 shipped with the validation half sensed and the bounds half neither implemented nor tested
lessons.text: When an implicit-requirement sweep resolves a bounds/limits dimension, name the concrete bound (page size, cap, or 'deliberately unbounded because X') — 'bounded like the shipped list conventions' names no assertion, and WSN-11 shipped with the validation half sensed and the bounds half neither implemented nor tested.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a get key default fallback whose only caller always writes the key is untestable through the public path pin it with a direct unit test or delete it else a mutation of the default survives
lessons.text: A .get(key, default) fallback whose only caller always writes the key is untestable through the public path — pin it with a direct unit test or delete it, else a mutation of the default survives.

lessons.key: ac_gap::before any paid live eval run assert every model identity the spec pins judge and generation against the resolved settings not just the prompt hash a git ignored env override can silently swap the model and the resume mismatch guard compares against the same drifted value
lessons.text: Before any paid live eval run, assert every model identity the spec pins (judge and generation) against the resolved settings, not just the prompt hash — a git-ignored .env override can silently swap the model and the resume mismatch guard compares against the same drifted value.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec ac requires an observable side channel progress log lines add a test capturing its output passing a discard callback in every test leaves the ac with zero evidence
lessons.text: When a spec AC requires an observable side channel (progress/log lines), add a test capturing its output — passing a discard callback in every test leaves the AC with zero evidence.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::paid multi run live studies should verify the provider credit balance covers the modeled estimate before the first unit a mid study credit exhaustion truncates the final run and turns the planned evidence into a recorded deviation
lessons.text: Paid multi-run live studies should verify the provider credit balance covers the modeled estimate before the first unit — a mid-study credit exhaustion truncates the final run and turns the planned evidence into a recorded deviation.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a feature reads committed data files derive fixtures from the newest real file not just the oldest the de noise study file repeats each case across two model arms and three runs so a case run index react key collided on all 36 rows while every fixture used run index null and passed
lessons.text: When a feature reads committed data files, derive fixtures from the newest real file, not just the oldest: the de-noise study file repeats each case across two model arms and three runs, so a case+run_index React key collided on all 36 rows while every fixture used run_index null and passed.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::before documenting a shape as unproducible grep every writer into that directory not just the obvious one the study runner writes status error lines with no citation valid into the same results dir the judge writes which a missing key means violation rule turned into a false citation failure
lessons.text: Before documenting a shape as unproducible, grep every writer into that directory, not just the obvious one: the study runner writes status-error lines with no citation_valid into the same results dir the judge writes, which a missing-key-means-violation rule turned into a false citation failure.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec clause demands a failure log without secrets door 40 pair the swallow and continue test with a caplog assertion naming the log record and asserting the raw token is absent session still created tests alone do not pin the log contract
lessons.text: When a spec clause demands a failure log without secrets (DOOR-40), pair the swallow-and-continue test with a caplog assertion naming the log record and asserting the raw token is absent — session-still-created tests alone do not pin the log contract.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a spec outcome phrased as an http status for a public route door 27 return 200 needs at least one route level request assertion jsdom render tests only pin content and silently assume the routing status half
lessons.text: A spec outcome phrased as an HTTP status for a public route (DOOR-27 return 200) needs at least one route-level request assertion; jsdom render tests only pin content and silently assume the routing/status half.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when sibling quota errors assert their honest copy body a new quota error door 18 in flight copy must assert its copy too status plus side effect assertions let the copy regress unnoticed
lessons.text: When sibling quota errors assert their honest-copy body, a new quota error (DOOR-18 in-flight copy) must assert its copy too — status-plus-side-effect assertions let the copy regress unnoticed.
